2607.18063.title: Adaptive Adversaries: A Multi-Turn, Multi-LLM Benchmark for LLM Agent Security
2607.18063.paper_summary: LLM-based agents process external content, exposing them to prompt injection and multi-turn manipulation. Most safety benchmarks evaluate defenders against fixed attack pools collected before evaluation, single-turn or multi-turn. We present a 21-scenario benchmark for \emph{adaptive multi-round attacks against memoryless LLM defenders}: an autonomous LLM attacker observes prior defender responses and pivots across rounds, while each defender response is evaluated as a fresh interaction. Holding the 21 scenarios, attackers, defenders, and structured-output scoring fixed, restricting scoring to the first attacker turn yields $0$-$1\%$ attack success rate (ASR); allowing 15 rounds of adaptive attack yields $5.4$-$14.0\%$. Pooling three frontier attacker LLMs uncovers $1.4$-$2.2\times$ as many unique successful attacks as the best single attacker, and the generated attacks have low cosine similarity ($0.02$-$0.14$) to attacks in existing benchmarks. Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 are tied in aggregate ($5.4\%$ each; overlapping $95\%$ CIs), but their weaknesses differ sharply: on one scenario Opus reaches $60\%$ ASR ($95\%$ CI $36$--$80\%$) while GPT-5.4 and Gemini each stay at $7\%$ (CI $1$-$30\%$; the gap is preserved in a higher-$N$ replication). $13$ of $21$ scenarios distinguish at least one defender pair, yet rankings disagree across scenarios (Kendall's $W = 0.19$). We release the benchmark -- 21 evaluation scenarios, 10 public development scenarios, the orchestrator, baseline harnesses, and a multi-attacker CLI -- plus 945 transcripts from the 3$\times$3 frontier matrix, an attack-replay dataset, and 18{,}422 gpt-oss-20b battles from an open competition's final scoring rounds.
2607.18063.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基礎的代理處理外部內容，使其暴露於提示注入和多回合操控之下。大多數安全基準評估防禦者對於在評估前收集的固定攻擊池的抵抗能力，無論是單回合還是多回合。我們提出了一個 21 種情境的基準，用於 \emph{對無記憶 LLM 防禦者的自適應多回合攻擊}：一個自主的 LLM 攻擊者觀察先前的防禦者回應並在回合間轉變，而每個防禦者的回應都被評估為一次新的互動。保持 21 種情境、攻擊者、防禦者和結構化輸出評分不變，將評分限制於第一個攻擊者回合可得 $0$-$1\%$ 的攻擊成功率 (ASR)；允許 15 回合的自適應攻擊則可得 $5.4$-$14.0\%$。將三個前沿攻擊者 LLM 聚合可揭示出 $1.4$-$2.2\times$ 的獨特成功攻擊數量，超過最佳單一攻擊者，且生成的攻擊與現有基準中的攻擊具有低餘弦相似度 ($0.02$-$0.14$)。Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 在總體上平手 ($5.4\%$ 各自；重疊的 $95\%$ CI)，但它們的弱點有明顯差異：在一個情境中，Opus 達到 $60\%$ 的 ASR ($95\%$ CI $36$--$80\%$)，而 GPT-5.4 和 Gemini 各自保持在 $7\%$ (CI $1$-$30\%$；在更高的 $N$ 重複中保持此差距)。$21$ 種情境中有 $13$ 種能區分至少一對防禦者，但在情境間的排名存在不一致 (Kendall's $W = 0.19$)。我們發布這個基準 -- 21 種評估情境、10 種公共開發情境、協調者、基準工具和一個多攻擊者 CLI -- 以及來自 3$\times$3 前沿矩陣的 945 份文字記錄、一個攻擊重播數據集，以及來自一個公開競賽最終評分回合的 18{,}422 場 gpt-oss-20b 戰鬥。
